create_sampler_greedy: create a Sampler instance with greedy sampling to generate text from a prompt string
sample_text_prompt: sample text from a Gemma model by passing a prompt string to the sample method
sample_batched_prompts: sample responses for multiple prompts by passing a list of strings to the sample method
sample_with_images: sample text from a prompt containing image tokens by passing images to the sample method
sample_with_return_state: sample text and return the SamplingState for multi-turn conversation by setting return_state to True
